name: Checklist
description: Goal in, verified checklist out: draft -> refine loop -> validate -> human approval.

config.label: Draft checklist
config.prompt:
Turn this goal into a markdown checklist.
Rules:
- 5-10 steps
- Each step on its own line as "- [ ] ..."
- Each step concrete and verifiable, in order
- Add done-criteria in parentheses

Goal:
{{input}}

config.label: Refine
config.prompt:
Improve this checklist. Make each step smaller, ordered, verifiable. Keep markdown checkboxes, 5-10 steps.

{{prev}}

config.label: Validate
